channel.title: Governance Digest
channel.description: New DAO governance proposals and discussions, summarized in plain English.

item.title: Tether America USD (USAT) on Aave Avalanche Assessments (aave)
item.description: Aave opened the assessment thread for listing Tether America USD (USAT) on Aave Avalanche.

item.title: Risk Stewards: Cap Increases on Aave V4 / 2026.10.26 (aave)
item.description: LlamaRisk recommends raising supply and borrow caps across Aave V4 on Ethereum and Arc, including USDC, USDG, WETH, weETH, LINK and syrupUSDC, citing demand and liquidity.

item.title: [Social] [7.3] Select OpenZeppelin to audit Governor Nexus (ens.eth)
item.description: ENS is voting on hiring OpenZeppelin to audit Governor Nexus, its new governance contracts, before any deployment. The audit is paid from an existing working-group budget, with no new DAO funding.

item.title: End Community Multisig Cancellation Power (compound)
item.description: A Compound proposal, now pending on-chain, would remove the Community Multisig's power to cancel governance proposals from 1 November 2026, after the multisig cancelled Proposal 618 before voting began.

item.title: [November 5, 2026] Proposed Changes to Spark for Upcoming Spell (sky)
item.description: Spark's 5 November spell proposes six changes on Base and Ethereum, including a new Base controller and USDC route to Ethereum and onboarding OUSD, plus one Sky Core change.

item.title: Mitigating Correlated Risk: Framework for Hybrid CSM Deployments and Provider Diversity Scoring (lido)
item.description: A Lido research post proposes a blueprint for Community Staking Module operators to run hybrid home and cloud setups, plus a provider diversity score, to cut correlated outage and slashing risk.

item.title: Should GnosisDAO fund an open-source integrity monitor for Gnosis bridges and consensus contracts? (gnosis)
item.description: A builder asks GnosisDAO to fund an open-source monitor that alerts when Gnosis bridge or consensus contracts are upgraded or their admins change. Retroactive pay plus an ongoing amount.

item.title: Global Dollar (USDG) on Aave Arbitrum Assessments (aave)
item.description: Aave opened the risk and technical assessment thread for listing Global Dollar (USDG) on Aave Arbitrum.
